Name: Fantasy Chess Pieces
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/T9A6d2I.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]I love chess when I'm not modding, I made this small mod when I found the amazing pieces yesterday, It's awesome that I can play it without leaving the game, thanks to Aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11580?tab=description]Chess Boards[/url] my farmer can be a chess player too xD[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2TX6iAE.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]This mod replaces all chess pieces to be fantasy themed, the pieces are different from the normal ones, you can look inside the folders to see how it works. [/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hNORhek.png[/img]﻿
[center]﻿
[size=3][url=https://nulltale.itch.io/]Null Tale[/url]﻿ for the beautiful [url=https://nulltale.itch.io/heroes-chess]chess pieces[/url]﻿ <3[/size][/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/n2YpLy5.png[/img]
[center][size=3][b]1[/b]. Download this mod, Content Patcher and Chess Boards

[b]2[/b]. Drop everything in the mods folder

[b]3[/b].  Enjoy!﻿
